headlines.title: Japan's Nikkei ekes out gain as tech shares recover from early losses
Japan stocks higher at close of trade; Nikkei 225 up 0.14%
Japan shares higher at close of trade; Nikkei 225 up 0.14%
Nikkei Slips as Oil Above $100 and BOJ Rate Fears Cap Gains
Japan’s 2014 Playbook Shows a Muscular Option to Move the Yen
Japanese Yen: Intervention risk supports against US Dollar – Commerzbank
Japanese Yen remains firm against US Dollar amid hawkish BoJ bets, US PPI data eyed

marketTone.ko: 오늘 일본 증시는 기술주 회복에 힘입어 닛케이 225 지수가 0.14% 소폭 상승하며 마감했습니다. 그러나 유가가 배럴당 100달러를 상회하고 일본은행(BOJ)의 금리 인상 우려가 지속되면서 상승폭은 제한적이었습니다. 한편, 엔화는 BOJ의 매파적 기조에 대한 기대감과 외환시장 개입 가능성으로 인해 달러 대비 강세를 유지했습니다. 투자자들은 향후 발표될 미국 생산자물가지수(PPI)에도 주목하고 있습니다.
marketTone.en: Japanese stocks closed marginally higher today, with the Nikkei 225 eking out a 0.14% gain as tech shares recovered from earlier losses. However, market upside was limited by concerns over oil prices exceeding $100 and fears of potential Bank of Japan rate hikes. Meanwhile, the Japanese Yen remained firm against the US Dollar, supported by hawkish BOJ bets and the persistent risk of currency intervention. Investors are also eyeing upcoming US PPI data for further direction.
